fact_dispositions.reason: Destination and argument roles are confirmed in the actual helper, not its rendered name. Its final X/Y velocity assignments overwrite animation velocity. Inside the strict threshold x18 becomes zero but velocity remains raw displacement; outside, normalized displacement is scaled by distance*x10. Rightward travel is conditional on attribute values, not guaranteed by subtraction alone.
